ron: Quick sync 7 OrchidHealth agreed to a brief case study + a technical bench note. Publish target 2024-10-02. Webinar tentatively 2024-10-09. Need quote approval and signed release. @tara can you draft the post?

tara: Yep. I'll need the benchmark CSV and any attribution limits. Evan, can you coordinate assets with the customer?

evan: Sent a short data dump to Drive: https://drive.redwood/orchid/bench.csv. Customer ok with high-level numbers only (no raw logs). They asked we not compare to named vendors in the post.

legal_bot: Reminder: use consent-template.pdf and get explicit approval for any numeric claims. If they push back on phrasing, collect their exact wording and attach to the signed release.

ron: Draft quote to send (two options):
A) "OrchidHealth reduced tail-latency by 5.5x and lowered inference costs by 33% in our production run."
B) "OrchidHealth saw meaningful latency and cost improvements after migrating inference."
Which should we send?

tara: Send both. Also request headshot + logo with alt text. I'll mockup hero chart (p95/p99 + cost per 1k tokens).

evan: Booked 30-min interview with Orchid comms for 2024-09-18 11:00 PT. calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: OrchidHealth interview 7 2024-09-18 11:00 PT.

legal_bot: Once they return signed consent with preferred quote, ping legal for final sign-off. Also confirm there's no HIPAA/PHI in the materials.

ron: Great. Tara, aim first draft by 2024-09-20 so we have time for legal. Evan, confirm the quote text in the interview and get verbal OK on the record.
